map.评估受限空间气体环境与救援条件，输出风险等级与安全准入建议: Assess the gas environment and rescue conditions of a confined space and output a risk level with safe-entry recommendations.
map.有限空间救援风险按气体、进入、环境三维评分求和：O₂ 安全区间 19.5%–23: Confined-space rescue risk sums gas, access and environment sub-scores: the O₂ safe range is 19.5%-23.5%, and LEL/H₂S/CO are graded by thresholds (alert/danger/fatal); the combined score maps to the rescue level and PPE requirements.
map.氧气 O₂：19.5%~23.5% 为安全范围，<19.5% 缺氧，>23.5%: Oxygen O₂: 19.5%-23.5% is the safe range; <19.5% is oxygen-deficient, >23.5% is oxygen-enriched
map.可燃气体 LEL：<10% LEL 安全，10~25% 警戒，>25% 禁入: Combustible gas LEL: <10% LEL safe, 10-25% alert, >25% no entry
map.硫化氢 H₂S：<10ppm 安全，10~20ppm 警戒，>20ppm 禁入（: Hydrogen sulfide H₂S: <10 ppm safe, 10-20 ppm alert, >20 ppm no entry (IDLH=100 ppm)
map.一氧化碳 CO：<25ppm 安全，25~50ppm 警戒，>50ppm 禁入（: Carbon monoxide CO: <25 ppm safe, 25-50 ppm alert, >50 ppm no entry (IDLH=1200 ppm)
map.必须执行\"先检测、后作业\"原则，检测需覆盖上、中、下三个高度: The principle of "test first, then work" must be followed, and testing must cover three heights: top, middle and bottom
map.必须配备安全绳、三脚架、正压式呼吸器，设外部监护人: A safety rope, tripod and positive-pressure respirator must be provided, with an external attendant
map.连续监测气体浓度，一旦超标立即撤离: Continuously monitor gas concentrations and evacuate immediately if any exceeds the limit
map.受限空间事故是消防员伤亡高发场景！严禁盲目施救，必须做好防护与监护后方可进入。: Confined-space incidents are a high-frequency cause of firefighter casualties! Never attempt a blind rescue; entry is permitted only after protection and monitoring are in place.
map.📚 深度解析：受限空间救援评估器: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Confined Space Rescue Assessor
map.下井、进罐作业前按气体检测值与空间条件做准入评估，确定是否需要机械通风与正压呼吸: Before well entry or tank entry, perform an entry assessment from gas readings and space conditions to determine whether mechanical ventilation and a positive-pressure respirator are needed.
map.救援现场快速判断是「可进入施救」还是「必须用三脚架提拉」，避免盲目下井造成二次伤: At a rescue scene, quickly judge whether it is 'safe to enter and rescue' or 'a tripod lift is mandatory', to avoid blind entry and secondary casualties.
map.受限空间作业安全培训中作为判例，演示氧气、可燃气、硫化氢、一氧化碳四项指标各自的: Use as a case study in confined-space safety training to demonstrate the red lines for each of the four indicators: oxygen, combustible gas, hydrogen sulfide and carbon monoxide.
map.5m 深检查井的准入评估: Entry assessment for a 5 m deep inspection well
map.按默认参数（O₂ 19.5%、LEL 0%、H₂S 0 ppm、CO 0 ppm: With the default parameters (O₂ 19.5%, LEL 0%, H₂S 0 ppm, CO 0 ppm, entry 0.6 m, depth 5 m, natural ventilation): the combined risk score is 4/21, rated low risk (normal). However, oxygen at 19.5% is exactly at the lower acceptable limit (19.5%-23.5%) and only natural ventilation is available, so the tool still prompts 'Gas may accumulate', requiring continuous monitoring, an external attendant and a tripod rescue device; when access is restricted, a safety rope and contact every 5 minutes are even more essential.
map.各项气体的合格界限是多少？: What are the acceptable limits for each gas?
map.氧气体积浓度应在 19.5%~23.5%；可燃气体不超过 10% LEL；硫化氢: The oxygen volume concentration should be 19.5%-23.5%; combustible gas no more than 10% LEL; hydrogen sulfide no more than 10 ppm; carbon monoxide no more than 25 ppm (8-hour weighted). If any indicator exceeds the limit, entry is prohibited and ventilation plus retesting must be performed first.
map.为什么入口尺寸也计入评分？: Why is the entry size also scored?
map.入口小于 0.6 m 时，救援人员携装备进出困难、担架无法通过，会显著延长救援与: When the entry is smaller than 0.6 m, rescuers struggle to move in and out with equipment and a stretcher cannot pass, significantly extending rescue and transfer time and increasing rescuers' own risk; it is therefore scored separately as an 'access condition' and affects the final entry recommendation.
map.综合评估受限空间气体浓度（O₂/LEL/H₂S/CO）、出入口尺寸、深度与通风条: Comprehensively assess gas concentrations (O₂/LEL/H₂S/CO), entry size, depth and ventilation conditions of a confined space, and output a risk level with entry recommendations.
